entities.name: Chinese Six Rites of Marriage
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: The Zhou Dynasty codified marriage into six formal rites (liuli): proposal, birthday matching, betrothal gifts, bride price, date selection, and the wedding ceremony. A matchmaker mediated all negotiations. The bride's and groom's horoscopes had to be compatible.
